SELECT json_build_object(
  'pending_decision', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.days_waiting DESC) FROM (
    SELECT i.id::text AS invoice_id, i.supplier_name, i.invoice_number, i.invoice_date,
      i.total_amount, i.category, i.trade_type, i.created_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - i.created_at))/86400)::int AS days_waiting,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM invoices i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
    WHERE i.status = 'pending_review'
      AND i.created_at < now() - INTERVAL '5 days'
    LIMIT 25
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'approved_unpaid', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.days_overdue DESC) FROM (
    SELECT i.id::text AS invoice_id, i.supplier_name, i.invoice_number, i.invoice_date,
      i.total_amount, i.approved_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - i.approved_at))/86400)::int AS days_overdue,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM invoices i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
    WHERE i.status = 'approved'
      AND i.paid_at IS NULL
      AND i.approved_at IS NOT NULL
      AND i.approved_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    LIMIT 20
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'disputed_stale', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.days_disputed DESC) FROM (
    SELECT i.id::text AS invoice_id, i.supplier_name, i.invoice_number, i.total_amount,
      i.created_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - i.created_at))/86400)::int AS days_disputed,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM invoices i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
    WHERE i.status = 'disputed'
      AND i.created_at < now() - INTERVAL '14 days'
    LIMIT 15
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'total_issues', (
    (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'pending_review' AND created_at < now() - INTERVAL '5 days')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'approved' AND paid_at IS NULL AND approved_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'disputed' AND created_at < now() - INTERVAL '14 days')
  )::int,
  'total_amount_pending', coalesce((SELECT round(sum(total_amount)::numeric, 2) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'pending_review' AND created_at < now() - INTERVAL '5 days'), 0)
) AS report;
